description: M&T Bank Corporation is a New York business corporation that has elected to be treated as a financial holding company under the Bank Holding Company Act and is a bank holding company under Article III-A of the New York Banking Law, and it was incorporated in November 1969. At December 31, 2025 it had two wholly-owned bank subsidiaries, M&T Bank and Wilmington Trust, N.A., which collectively offer a wide range of retail and commercial banking, wealth management, trust and institutional services to their customers, and the company had consolidated total assets of $213.5 billion, deposits of $166.9 billion and shareholders' equity of $29.2 billion at that date, with its principal executive offices located in Buffalo, New York. M&T Bank is a banking corporation incorporated under the laws of the State of New York, a member of the Federal Reserve System and the FHLB System, with its deposits insured by the FDIC through its DIF up to applicable limits.
